data: Is the solid blue line always higher than the dashed blue line in the middle plot?

The solid blue line represents the Jaccard similarity for the built-in method when the two models agree on the predicted label. The dashed blue line represents the Jaccard similarity for the built-in method when the two models disagree on the predicted label. The caption states that the similarity is not always greater when the two models agree on the predicted labels than when they disagree. This implies that there are instances where the solid blue line is lower than the dashed blue line. Therefore, the solid blue line is not always higher than the dashed blue line.
